versions.changelog:
Initial release – Diagnose Huawei Cloud CDN domain ownership verification failures, providing structured read-only diagnostics:

- Automatically detects the required domain ownership verification method (DNS TXT record or file verification).
- Probes the actual verification record or file using Python scripts and confirms against the expected content.
- Delivers a structured JSON diagnosis report with root cause analysis and recommended fixes.
- Enforces strict read-only constraints by refusing all write, modify, or delete operations.
- Responds to both Chinese and English trigger keywords related to domain ownership verification issues.
